rules.message: No conditional statements allowed in Fragments/Activities. Move logic to ViewModel.
rules.description: Fragments and Activities must not contain if/else, try/catch, or throw statements

rules.message: ViewModels must extend AndroidViewModel for context access
rules.description: All ViewModels must extend AndroidViewModel instead of ViewModel
ViewBinding is required, findViewById is forbidden

rules.message: Do not pass Context to ViewModel. Use getApplication() instead
rules.description: Context must not be passed from UI to ViewModel

rules.message: ViewModel methods must not return values. Use MutableLiveData instead
rules.description: ViewModel methods should return void and update LiveData

rules.message: Internal ViewModel methods should be private
rules.description: Helper methods in ViewModel should be private
